task: ae.tsblock: delta-of-delta varint compressed, CRC-checked time-series block file with footer index and atomic writes
reasoning_summary: Designed a block file with magic header, CRC-framed delta-of-delta zigzag-varint blocks, a CRC-protected footer index and a trailer, written to a temp file and atomically moved on close. Tests were written first, including exhaustive truncation and every-byte-flip corruption checks, a brute-force range oracle and a blocks-decoded counter proving index pruning. The only failure was a test compile error (missing throws), fixed in attempt 2.
